Container.Name: coder
Container.Overview:
Coder (coder.com) provisions self-hosted cloud development environments (workspaces) defined with Terraform. Workspaces run as Docker containers on this Unraid server through the mounted docker socket, and users connect with VS Code, JetBrains, the browser, or SSH.
This build wraps the official ghcr.io/coder/coder image with an Unraid-friendly entrypoint: - PUID/PGID support and automatic ownership fixes for the appdata folder. - Automatic docker socket access (no manual --group-add needed). - First-run bootstrap: creates the admin account from the Bootstrap Admin fields. - Applies the Premium license from the License Key field at startup, and skips it on later starts if it is already installed.
IMPORTANT: Access URL must be an address workspaces and your browser can reach, for example http://192.168.1.10:7080 or https://coder.example.com behind a reverse proxy. It cannot be localhost. Blank optional fields are ignored.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: coder.com dev environment workspace cloud ide terraform code-server
Container.Requires: Internet access on first start (downloads the built-in PostgreSQL binaries). Set Access URL to a LAN IP or domain that workspaces can reach.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Coder dashboard and API. Must match the port in Access URL unless you use a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent data: built-in PostgreSQL database, config and Terraform cache. Set the appdata share to cache-only (or use /mnt/cache/appdata/coder) so the database does not run on the FUSE array path.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Lets Coder create workspace containers on this server. Required for the built-in Docker template.

Config.Name: Access URL
Config.Description: External URL users and workspaces use to reach Coder, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7080 or https://coder.example.com. Must NOT be localhost or 127.0.0.1.

Config.Name: License Key
Config.Description: Optional Coder Premium license (the long JWT string). Applied automatically on start when the Bootstrap Admin fields are filled in. Leave blank for the free tier.

Config.Name: Bootstrap Admin Email
Config.Description: Email for the first admin account. Together with username and password this creates the account on first start and is used to apply the license. Leave all three blank to set up the admin in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Bootstrap Admin Username
Config.Description: Username for the first admin account. Letters, numbers and single hyphens only, up to 32 characters.

Config.Name: Bootstrap Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the first admin account. Coder requires a reasonably strong password: 12 or more characters mixing cases, digits and symbols, 64 max. Keep it current here if you change it in the UI, otherwise license automation stops working.

Config.Name: Bootstrap Admin Full Name
Config.Description: Optional display name for the first admin account.

Config.Name: Wildcard Access URL
Config.Description: Wildcard hostname for workspace web apps and port forwarding, e.g. *.coder.example.com. Needs matching DNS and TLS. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL URL
Config.Description: External PostgreSQL 13+ connection string, e.g. postgresql://coder:secret@192.168.1.10:5432/coder?sslmode=disable. Leave blank to use the built-in database stored in Appdata.

Config.Name: Telemetry
Config.Description: Send anonymised usage data to Coder.

Config.Name: Update Check
Config.Description: Show a notice in the dashboard when a new Coder release is available.

Config.Name: Disable Password Auth
Config.Description: Only allow OIDC or GitHub login. Note: license automation logs in with the bootstrap admin password, so keep this false if you rely on it.

Config.Name: OIDC Issuer URL
Config.Description: OIDC provider issuer URL, e.g. https://auth.example.com/application/o/coder/.

Config.Name: OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: OIDC client ID.

Config.Name: OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: OIDC client secret.

Config.Name: OIDC Allow Signups
Config.Description: Let new users register through OIDC.

Config.Name: GitHub OAuth Client ID
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth app client ID for GitHub login.

Config.Name: GitHub OAuth Client Secret
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth app client secret.

Config.Name: GitHub Allowed Orgs
Config.Description: Comma-separated GitHub organisations whose members may log in. Required when GitHub login is enabled unless CODER_OAUTH2_GITHUB_ALLOW_EVERYONE is set via Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: GitHub Allow Signups
Config.Description: Let new users register through GitHub.

Config.Name: TLS Enable
Config.Description: Terminate HTTPS inside the container on the TLS port using the certificate below. Most Unraid setups use a reverse proxy instead and keep this false.

Config.Name: TLS Certificates
Config.Description: Folder holding the TLS certificate and key when TLS Enable is true.

Config.Name: TLS Cert File
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the PEM certificate. Only used when TLS Enable is true.

Config.Name: TLS Key File
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the PEM private key. Only used when TLS Enable is true.

Config.Name: TLS Port
Config.Description: HTTPS port, only used when TLS Enable is true.

Config.Name: STUN Servers
Config.Description: Comma-separated STUN servers for direct connections, e.g. stun.l.google.com:19302. Leave blank for the Coder default. Use the value 'disable' to turn STUN off.

Config.Name: Prometheus Metrics
Config.Description: Expose Prometheus metrics on the Metrics port.

Config.Name: Metrics Port
Config.Description: Prometheus metrics port, only used when Prometheus Metrics is true.

Config.Name: Provisioner Daemons
Config.Description: Number of concurrent Terraform provisioners. Lower this on small servers.

Config.Name: Experiments
Config.Description: Comma-separated experimental features to enable, or * for all.

Config.Name: Log Filter
Config.Description: Regex to enable debug logs for matching loggers. Leave blank for normal logging.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the Coder process runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the Coder process runs as. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: HTTP Address
Config.Description: Internal bind address. Do not change.

Config.Name: TLS Address
Config.Description: Internal TLS bind address. Do not change.

Config.Name: Prometheus Address
Config.Description: Internal metrics bind address. Do not change.
